source_caption_text:
BigXthaPlug is back with “LITE” featuring Belly Gang Kushington ahead of his new album “Better Over Time”, dropping October 30 👀🔥

BigXthaPlug links up with Belly Gang Kushington for “LITE,” bringing that heavy Texas rap sound to the track. The video moves from a hazy nightclub setting into a late-night drive, with shots of a pianist playing alone in an open field.

“LITE” is the lead single from BigXthaPlug’s upcoming album BETTER OVER TIME, which is set to arrive October 30. The project marks a return to his core rap sound after I Hope You’re Happy.

The album rollout is already picking up, with BigXthaPlug teasing the project through hometown billboards and a lineup of guest features. “LITE” gives fans another look at what’s coming before the album drops.
